title: ID0401569-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S2 170003381] allOutletsUnavailable
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Mainbreaker error
Root cause:
3VA27 only mainbreaker - seems to be a problem during startup fuse where we see a drop in the voltage for QA29 command
Workaround:
Change 24V for QA29 command from FC14 to FC16
Final Solution: Being discussed by R&D
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active

Hi Johannes,
After today's chat I presented to you a workaround (that apparently was asked during your escalation meeting) to change the 24V of QA29 from FC14 to FC16.
If this issue ever happens again please do this workaround until we find a final solution as this appears to be only related to 3VA27 (only in SiD400).
I will update you as soon as we have a definite answer.
Thank you and have a nice weekend!
Best regards,
Francisco
